credits: American folk song / William Steffe; words by Julia Ward Howe
Music: CCEH tune 000510, Battle Hymn, four-part score
Text: The Public Domain Song Anthology (Berger/Israels, 2020), printed p.38 / PDF p.58
Composite edition: CCEH music with the previously retained first stanza and refrain
rights: CCEH labels this music Public domain and identifies an American folk song / William Steffe, 1852. Specific historical harmonizer and printed source edition are unidentified.
CCEH explicitly permits copying, modifying, distributing, publishing and performing its score files. The music declaration is archive evidence, not independent arrangement-history proof.

Only the previously retained first stanza and refrain from the Berger/Israels anthology are used. The anthology asserts US public-domain underlying works and dedicates its new contributions under CC0 1.0.

CCEH warns that copyright rules vary by country. No blanket worldwide clearance or recording-specific arrangement clearance is claimed. Retained text uses the prior anthology US assertion and CC0 waiver to the extent legally possible.

Music: CCEH tune 000510, American folk song / William Steffe; harmonizer unidentified. Words: Julia Ward Howe, retained from David Berger and Chuck Israels (2020), The Public Domain Song Anthology, Aperio Press, https://doi.org/10.32881/book2.
CCEH declares the music and files public domain; the historical harmonizer and printed edition are unidentified. No blanket worldwide clearance is claimed.
Retained anthology text: underlying US public-domain assertion; new anthology contributions CC0 1.0.
provenance.territory: CCEH warns that copyright rules vary by country. No blanket worldwide clearance or recording-specific arrangement clearance is claimed. Retained text uses the prior anthology US assertion and CC0 waiver to the extent legally possible.
editionNotes: Stable hymn/source ID and both book memberships are preserved; only this selected edition is replaced.
Four selectable editorial SATB tracks preserve the upper/lower note members of the two CCEH staves, including six shared lower-staff unisons; the source itself does not name SATB voices.
CCEH music has no lyrics. Existing first stanza/refrain words and all 81 pitched-event lyric labels are retained verbatim from the previous anthology edition; no new stanzas are added.

Compared with the prior G-major melody: B-flat key (+3 semitones), untied pickup, whole-note verse cadence, half-note first two refrain cadences, and final dotted half without a trailing quarter rest. All 81 written melody pitches otherwise match after transposition.
The incompatible anthology chord layer is removed. Music and text have separate source attributions.
CCEH public-domain assertion is retained with unidentified-harmonizer and territory caveats.
The prior melody-only edition is identified by source SHA-256 6c111a2701c7f6cf9e454fb7027a601d236c8c6325c3ec8b7c062f3265fc06fe.
Four editorial SATB tracks separate the upper and lower notes of each source staff; the source does not name SATB parts.
Music preserves CCEH's B-flat key, untied pickup, sustained cadences and three-beat final bar. No anthology chord layer is retained.
CCEH supplies no lyrics. Every prior lyric field and its pitched-event underlay is retained; no additional stanzas are introduced.
CCEH declares the music and files public domain; the historical harmonizer and printed edition are unidentified. No blanket worldwide clearance is claimed.
Retained anthology text: underlying US public-domain assertion; new anthology contributions CC0 1.0.
changes: Imported the selected ABCJS-compatible edition without changing notation or printed lyrics.
Replaced melody-only anthology music with the faithful CCEH full harmony, preserving the previously selected words and underlay.
Editorial upper/lower split, without added notes or harmony.
All prior w: fields unchanged; the first Mine spans two untied source notes.
